catalog.label: context.reference
catalog.text: These operations compose ordinary Octopus runs through checked file effects. create_run starts a task in one call from the installation defaults. followup_task, send_message and interrupt_run reach a connected run; list_runs shows this run and its connected runs; wait_for_runs waits for their communication. To attach tools, rooms, context or routes to this run, use preview_current_run and then amend_current_run with the same amendment_key and an explicit complete selection; inspect_authoring shows the current one. preview_run, preview_revision and revise_run work with exact authored files. A new run forms its authority from its own worker ceiling and EE chain; a descriptor on disk alone grants nothing.

operations.name: inspect_authoring
operations.description: Show this run's roots, creation defaults, current grant and installed descriptors. Not needed before create_run; use it before amending this run or authoring exact files. Makes no edits.

operations.name: preview_current_run
operations.description: Preview adding or repairing capabilities on this current run. First inspect_authoring for the complete current selection. Supply every selection field explicitly, or an authored future run_record and its dependency writes. The preview checks real descriptor references, policy formation, each publication stage and preservation of accepted work. It applies no effects. Keep one amendment_key for the matching apply.

publications.description: Pinned entries from readable bound collections, added to the complete current selection. Each pin selects an exact revision; inline content adds context and grants no tools. Omitted or empty publications adds no entries.

run_record.description: Complete proposed future record based on expected_before. Preserve private continuity, accepted checkpoints and current identity; the owner rebases only the validated future-contract delta onto the checked tip.

expected_before_hash.description: Exact content_hash returned by the granted file.read of this run before editing its future contract.

expected_before.description: The complete observed run record before the proposed edit. Its hash and checked history must be proved before any effect.

operations.name: amend_current_run
operations.description: Apply the same reviewed current-run amendment using ordinary granted file effects and the provider-owned checked run edit. Preserve accepted waits, pending results, writer and provider identity. Add dependencies before activation, then read back the installed run. Newly granted tools and context become available after the final checked result. A partial or refused effect returns evidence for repair; it is never reported as a successful rollback.

operations.name: preview_run
operations.description: Optional dry run of create_run: prepare the same request and show its exact descriptor, policy and binding file edits without applying them. Useful for an authored graph or an unfamiliar selection; pass the same creation_key to create_run to apply it. The plan grants no authority.

operations.name: create_run
operations.description: Start a task: title and text are enough. The installation defaults choose the EE, worker, provider, model, rooms and tools, connect the new run to this one and return its result here. Add ee_id for a project, context_artifacts or publications for bound knowledge, and other fields only when the work needs them. Returns the new run and its admitted assignment; completion arrives later as the task's own return. authored takes a complete explicit run graph instead of the defaults and cannot be mixed with them.

operations.name: list_runs
operations.description: Show this run and the runs connected to it, with their receive interfaces, from the current grant and record.

operations.name: send_message
operations.description: Queue an artifact-backed message for a connected run at its exact receive interface.

operations.name: followup_task
operations.description: Send a follow-up to a connected run through its declared receive interface under the current grant.

operations.name: interrupt_run
operations.description: Request interruption through a connected run's declared receive interface; the result proves admission, not that work has stopped.

operations.name: wait_for_runs
operations.description: Wait for admitted run communication without inventing a runtime scheduler or resending work.

operations.name: preview_revision
operations.description: Validate exact edits to an existing peer run and related descriptors without applying them. Preserve accepted checkpoint contracts and inspect every publication stage. Do not edit the in-flight caller through this operation.

operations.name: revise_run
operations.description: Apply checked, validated file edits to an existing peer run and its descriptor dependencies. Optional seed emits through its exact declared interface; without seed, publishes the authored waits. Do not edit the in-flight caller through this operation.

native_tool_namespace.name: formed_interfaces
native_tool_namespace.description: Tools admitted through exact Octopus interface grants. Use their advertised methods and schemas. A native Code Mode result is a string: first line compact JSON, then optional image data URLs. Split at the first newline before JSON.parse; forward subsequent image URLs with image(). Tool result JSON carries tool, correlation_id, ok, body and error; interface operations use their declared schema. Inspect the complete returned value in JavaScript and emit selected evidence with text(). Transport failures are errors, never partial success. A model_projection head_tail preview lacks omitted fields. Artifact references do not grant reads, and payload paths are not an access shortcut. Code Mode store/load retain serializable values within the live session; no app/browser SDK is installed here.
